severity_current_mapping_legend.Critical: would map to an Immunefi Critical impact (theft / permanent freeze / insolvency, excluding bonds and fee vaults) IF it were live and unknown
severity_current_mapping_legend.High: Immunefi High (temporary freeze; incorrectly proven withdrawal mitigated by delay; incorrectly resolved game not detected by op-dispute-mon allowing invalid withdrawal; DLT: sequencer theft / total shutdown / freeze needing hardfork)
severity_current_mapping_legend.Medium: Immunefi Medium (incorrectly resolved game detected / not allowing withdrawal; bond withdrawal; fee-vault theft; L2 tx confirmation halt with forced inclusion)
severity_current_mapping_legend.None: below the programme threshold, privileged-only, self-harm, bond-only griefing, tooling/validator-only, or an explicitly known/out-of-scope class. NOTE: the mapping describes the impact class of the finding AS REPORTED; every finding here is KNOWN and therefore not reportable.

root_cause_vocabulary.ACCESS_CONTROL_MISSING: a state-changing or value-releasing entrypoint lacks (or mis-resolves) its caller check
root_cause_vocabulary.INPUT_VALIDATION_MISSING: attacker- or operator-supplied value is not range/format/identity checked on-chain (includes validator-script gaps)
root_cause_vocabulary.INVERTED_OR_WRONG_CONDITION: a comparison, ordering or boolean predicate is wrong
root_cause_vocabulary.REENTRANCY_STATE_CLOBBER: re-entry (or nested finalize/relay) clobbers a sentinel such as l2Sender / xDomainMsgSender or uses it as a guard incorrectly
root_cause_vocabulary.GAS_ACCOUNTING: min-gas / 63-64 / reserve / base-gas computations that decide whether a non-replayable step records its outcome
root_cause_vocabulary.REPLAY_OR_DOUBLE_SPEND: one economic object can be proven/relayed/finalized more than once or re-armed
root_cause_vocabulary.INITIALIZATION: initializer / reinitializer / implementation-initialisation problems, including re-running initialize on live state
root_cause_vocabulary.UPGRADE_STORAGE_LAYOUT: slot layout, gaps, spacers, immutables<->storage moves
root_cause_vocabulary.UPGRADE_SEQUENCING: ordering, atomicity, skip paths and tooling (OPCM / scripts / validators) of an upgrade or migration
root_cause_vocabulary.PAUSE_COVERAGE: what the pause covers, which identifier/pointer decides it, and paths that escape or silently lift it
root_cause_vocabulary.PROOF_VERIFICATION: binding between a withdrawal proof, an output/super root, a chain id, a game and a registry
root_cause_vocabulary.DISPUTE_GAME_LOGIC: clock, bond, move/step/resolve mechanics inside a game
root_cause_vocabulary.ANCHOR_STATE: what the anchor is, who can set it and how it is (re)interpreted
root_cause_vocabulary.GAME_TYPE_LIFECYCLE: respected game type, retirement timestamp, blacklist and their cut-overs
root_cause_vocabulary.VM_SEMANTICS: on-chain MIPS/MIPS64 step vs spec vs off-chain Cannon divergence
root_cause_vocabulary.DERIVATION_CONSENSUS: op-node / op-geth / kona derivation or execution divergence, including proof-program panics
root_cause_vocabulary.DOS_RESOURCE: griefing, unbounded work, liveness of nodes or of a function
root_cause_vocabulary.ACCOUNTING_CONSERVATION: ETH/token custody not matching liabilities, stranded or duplicated value
root_cause_vocabulary.CROSS_DOMAIN_IDENTITY: who the sender/creator is across domains or call layers (aliasing, tx.origin, msg.sender through factories)
root_cause_vocabulary.TOKEN_SEMANTICS: non-standard tokens, token-pair identity, mint/burn vs escrow branch
root_cause_vocabulary.STALE_STATE_AFTER_MIGRATION: an object created under release N keeps living and is read, mis-read or orphaned by release N+k
root_cause_vocabulary.CONFIG_TRUST: safety delegated to a privileged/off-chain input (deploy input, anchor, prestate, guardian, dependency set)
root_cause_vocabulary.SPEC_MISMATCH: code vs specification/documentation difference without a direct exploit

findings.title: Allocation overflow could allow arbitrary code execution (mmap pointer wraps; heap can overlap text/data)
findings.required_state: guest program driven to allocate until heap pointer wraps (see 3.2.1)
findings.attacker_model: L2 tx sender able to shape op-program memory use
findings.impact: mmap returns memory overlapping program text -> attacker-controlled MIPS code executed inside the fault proof => wrong output root provable
findings.exact_commit: 71b93116738ee98c9f8713b1a5dfe626ce06c1b2 (p3; README maps to op-contracts/v1.4.0); review Jun 3-21 2024 for Base/Coinbase
findings.fix_strategy: acknowledged, "fixing at a later date"; recommendation: allocation limit + non-overlapping region
findings.scope_assumptions: MIPS.sol, MIPSInstructions (single-threaded 32-bit Cannon) and Go counterpart mips_instructions.go (p3-10).
findings.explicit_out_of_scope: Security model assumes an honest, bug-free Go MIPS compiler and a correct op-program (several findings are "only if compiler emits X"). FaultDisputeGame/PreimageOracle reviewed separately (Spearbit No-MIPS). No fix review in report: responses are "Acknowledged / fix at a later date".
findings.residual_assumptions: heap growth bounded by address space in 64-bit MT-Cannon; GC enabled
findings.sibling_paths_not_reviewed: Go cannon mipsevm (must match)

findings.fix_strategy: fuzz test + semgrep rule marking try/catch as EIP-150 safe (PR 14144); monitoring of anchor age

findings.scope_assumptions: CHANGES in the two commits: dispute game validation moved to wasRespectedGameTypeWhenCreated / isGameProper / isGameClaimValid; single anchorGame; two-step resolve/closeGame; bond distribution modes NORMAL/REFUND; legacy games explicitly rejected (p2,7-9).
findings.explicit_out_of_scope: Only the diffs; MIPS, DGF, DelayedWETH design (I-02 acknowledged as intentional).
findings.residual_assumptions: SAFETY CONDITION: gas cost of the try-callee is not much larger than the remainder of the caller; changes with gas repricing (Amsterdam) or with heavier setAnchorState (super roots)
